title: Mountain High — Meet Jill
heygenScriptShort: Hey — I'm Jill. Welcome to Mountain High Medicinals. Hippie botanist, grow expert, 21 and over. Flip a type card for indica, sativa, hybrid, hemp, or ruderalis. If you need a locksmith, we cover Long Beach and L.A. Same number on the card.
